data.one_liner: Easily create custom controls that respond correctly to mouse and keyboard.
data.what_it_does: Wraps FocusableActionDetector to quickly create custom controls that handle tab key traversal, focus and rollover states, modified mouse cursors, and keyboard shortcuts. Allows you to build custom interactive components using a builder method.
use_when: You need to build a custom button or interactive control that supports keyboard traversal and shortcuts.
You want consistent hover, focus, and pressed states across different platforms.
avoid_when: You are satisfied with using standard Material or Cupertino buttons without custom styling needs.
strengths: Handles complex focus, hover, and keyboard shortcut logic automatically.
Cross-platform support including web, desktop, and mobile.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on standard Flutter focus mechanics, which can still be verbose for highly complex nested control trees.
